stats.notes: IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023 first-time students): 11,901 applicants, 10,836 admitted, 2,841 enrolled. College Navigator fall 2024: 11,584 applicants, 91% admitted. IPEDS reports no nonresident-alien applicant counts for Missouri State, so international admit figures are null; nonresidents are about 2% of undergraduates (fall 2024, rounded). Undergraduate enrollment 20,584 (fall 2024) includes many dual-credit high school students; student-faculty ratio 21:1. No readable Common Data Set was found for this college, so this is the IPEDS baseline; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $9,502, out-of-state $18,770; on-campus food and housing $11,006, other $3,924; total_coa_usd is the out-of-state on-campus total.
